commit_note: remote working tree verified byte-identical to this commit before the run
purpose: First CAM3R training run after the paper-fidelity pass. Proves the pipeline trains and evaluates end to end on real ADT with the paper's prescribed initialization, and measures how far 40 epochs on one GPU gets.

init.cross_view_tensors: 1016/1128 (98% of 542.8M params; dec_blocks.*.norm_ctx has no CroCo counterpart)

train.phase2_note: not run; no source declares supports_heterogeneous, so phase 2 would degenerate to phase 1

eval.note: results_init.json is the same eval on the same held-out pairs with the pretrained backbones but no CAM3R training -- the before to results.json's after.

caveats: Eq. 10 degenerates during this run. L_trans = s^2 ||u_pred - u_gt||^2 with s = eta_pred/eta_gt detached; nothing in Eq. 11 anchors the pointmap magnitude (Eq. 7 divides it out), so s drifted 0.090 -> 0.006 and the translation-direction term lost ~3 orders of magnitude of weight. See train_log.json pose/scale. RTA numbers here are therefore weakly supervised, and the translation improvement that did happen came mostly from the first few epochs while s was still large.

Pointmaps are up to scale by construction, so predicted radial distance is ~0.008 in arbitrary units, not metres. Every metric reported is scale-free (RRA/RTA angular, mAA@30 angular, depth via scale_only alignment).

loss/total is not a progress metric: the DUSt3R confidence term sigma*L - alpha*log(sigma) is unbounded below and drove total negative. Read loss/angular and pose/rot_rad instead. Learned confidences were healthy (min 2.2, median ~10, none below 1).
40 epochs on 1 GPU vs the paper's 300-500 on 4xH200, and ADT only vs the paper's five corpora.
